name: colibri
description_en: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
readme_excerpt: Website · Discord · English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Italiano Tiny engine, immense model. Run frontier MoE models — 744B to 2.8T parameters — on consumer and heterogeneous hardware, in pure C with zero engine dependencies, by treating storage, RAM, and VRAM as a single inference hierarchy (AI memory multitiering). Eight families run today: GLM-5.2 (744B), GLM-5.3-Flash (321B, with vision), Inkling (975B), Kimi K3 (2.8T), DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B + 51B n-gram), Qwen3.6 (35B-A3B)…
